cases.name: ds-names-first
cases.note: a table whose first column is names: the reading is the name, no title, the pointer at the start

cases.name: ds-rows
cases.note: three rows of a name-first table, nested progress arcs

cases.name: ds-number-first
cases.note: a table whose first column is the number: the values, still no names

cases.name: ds-encode-ignored
cases.note: encode written anyway (value, itemName, tooltip): read by nobody

cases.name: ds-encode-index
cases.note: encode.value 1 by index on a number table: still the first column

cases.name: ds-layout-row
cases.note: seriesLayoutBy 'row': the first line is the first dimension

cases.name: ds-layout-row-names
cases.note: seriesLayoutBy 'row' with the names' line first

cases.name: ds-series-dims
cases.note: the series' dimensions over a headless table: the first one

cases.name: ds-dataset-dims-number
cases.note: the dataset's dimensions type 'number' on a column of words: parsed, 'Rate' NaN, '7' 7

cases.name: ds-dims-ordinal
cases.note: declared 'ordinal' over numbers: the cells as written

cases.name: ds-series-dims-type
cases.note: the series' dimensions type 'number' over a column of words

cases.name: ds-objects
cases.note: object rows: the first field, no names

cases.name: ds-mixed-column
cases.note: an ordinal column holding a word, a number, a numeric word and true

cases.name: ds-null-empty
cases.note: an ordinal column's null and '' are 0 to the dial and '' to the reading (min -50)

cases.name: ds-formatter
cases.note: a template formatter over a name: '{value} %'

cases.name: ds-no-header
cases.note: a headless table of words and numbers

cases.name: ds-header-false
cases.note: sourceHeader false: the header line is a row

cases.name: ds-numeric-words
cases.note: a column of numeric words is not ordinal: parsed

cases.name: data-arrays-ordinal
cases.note: data arrays whose first item starts with a word: the cells as written

cases.name: data-dims-number
cases.note: data arrays whose first word is declared 'number' by the series' dimensions: parsed, NaN

cases.name: ds-null-inherit
cases.note: the reading's 'inherit' over two bands: a null cell is 0 (the first band), a word NaN (the last)

cases.name: ds-count-words
cases.note: valueAnimation over cells that are words: no count, the words throughout (sampled at 300 ms)

cases.name: data-encode-ignored
cases.note: data arrays with encode.value 1: the first element

cases.name: data-objects
cases.note: items with values a number, a numeric word, a word: a number column

cases.name: auto-split-none
cases.note: splitLine 'auto' with no bands: the track's colour

cases.name: auto-tick-none
cases.note: axisTick 'auto' with no bands: the track's colour

cases.name: auto-tick-bands
cases.note: axisTick 'auto' over two bands

cases.name: auto-pointer-none
cases.note: pointer.itemStyle.color 'auto' with no bands: the track's colour

cases.name: auto-progress-none
cases.note: progress.itemStyle.color 'auto' with no bands

cases.name: auto-item-colour
cases.note: an item's itemStyle.color 'auto': its pointer and arc take the band under its value; another item its palette colour

cases.name: auto-series-colour
cases.note: the series' itemStyle.color 'auto': the palette's colour (seriesStyleTask), not the band

cases.name: auto-item-colour-none
cases.note: an item's itemStyle.color 'auto' with no bands: the track's colour

cases.name: item-pointer
cases.note: items' own pointer width, length, offsetCenter; the series' for the third

cases.name: item-pointer-colour
cases.note: items' own pointer.itemStyle and progress.itemStyle colours

cases.name: string-extent
cases.note: min '10', max '210', startAngle '180', endAngle '0' written as strings

cases.name: nan-start-null
cases.note: startAngle null: undefined, the angle NaN -- no axis line, no ticks, no labels, no arc; the pointer at rotation 0

cases.name: nan-end-word
cases.note: endAngle 'x': NaN -- the first label and split line only, no axis line, no arc, the pointer at rotation 0

cases.name: nan-min-null
cases.note: min null: NaN -- every label 'NaN', the pointer at the end, the arc full, the reading's 'inherit' the last band

cases.name: nan-max-word
cases.note: max 'abc': NaN -- every label 'NaN', the pointer at the start, no arc, the reading's 'inherit' the first band

cases.name: nan-both-angles
cases.note: startAngle 'a' and endAngle null; two rows

cases.name: nan-extent-true
cases.note: min true (1) and max ' 90 ' (90): JS numbers

cases.name: ds-missing-cell
cases.note: an ordinal column whose second row is shorter than the header: undefined -- NaN to the dial, '' to the reading (min -50)

cases.name: data-missing-cell
cases.note: data arrays: an empty one and one with null, under an ordinal first item

cases.name: ds-missing-inherit
cases.note: the reading's 'inherit' over two bands: a missing cell NaN (the last band), a null 0 (the first)
